blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Investors looking to expand in the Philippines face mounting economic and political uncertainties, as a new report flagged “elevated” risks in the country’s business environment and warned that conditions could deteriorate further. In its inaugural Philippine Political and Country Outlook Report, professional services firm WR Advisory Group gave the country an overall risk score of 10.375 out of 25 for the second quarter of 2026, placing it in the elevated-risk category with a deteriorating outlook.
